description: The restructured reference with a mixed set of faults: a mode switch now restarts the current chapter (contradicting a mandatory item), a browser visual editor is added (excluded scope), and the release-check summary no longer names the failed check (weakened). Stale test-plan expectations make the artifacts inconsistent. The artifacts also make Tailwind the default styling and redirect the root URL to the sample, contradicting two simulated-user answers in conversation.jsonl.

contradicted_items.change: Changing mode restarts at the first step of the current chapter.

added_scope.change: A browse-mode visual editor that drags entities, retypes narration, and saves to source; the non-goal is removed.

weakened_items.change: The summary still reads PASS or FAIL with a non-zero exit on failure, but no longer names the failed check.

quality_defects.defect: AR-3 still expects the step to survive mode switches; the changed specification restarts at the first step of the current chapter. RC-2 still expects FAIL to name the failed check, which only adds detail to the specified FAIL summary and is not a contradiction.
The added in-place visual editing requirement has no planned check.

planted_fidelity_contradictions.change: Generated presentations are styled with Tailwind utility classes, installed when the first presentation is created.
The root URL redirects to the sample; there is no landing page.

notes: Exchange 4 concerns a graded item (INV-031); the artifacts respect it and coverage, not fidelity, would own any contradiction.
INV-074 stays met: the sample is still listed in the manifest and reachable (now via the root redirect).
